decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Bitter Triumph, Thoughtseize, and Cache Grab to control the opponent's hand and resources, while also utilizing cards like Formidable Speaker, Greasefang, Okiba Boss, and Parhelion II to generate tokens and create powerful board presence. The deck also includes mana ramp and fixing with cards like Multiversal Passage and Agadeem's Awakening to ensure a consistent mana base for casting the key combo pieces.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using a combination of cheap spells, prowess creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, and direct burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The deck focuses on efficiently using mana and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent and win the game before they can stabilize. By utilizing a mix of creatures and spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through fast and relentless aggression.

This deck aims to ramp up quickly with cards like Agadeem's Awakening and Multiversal Passage to get out powerful combo pieces like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. It focuses on generating a strong board presence with cards like Esika's Chariot and Overlord of the Balemurk while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Cache Grab. With a mix of powerful creatures and efficient removal, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and quickly secure the win through a combination of combo pieces and strategic plays.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent by utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while supporting them with efficient burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The deck also includes card draw and selection tools like Sleight of Hand and Stormchaser's Talent to maintain momentum. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility, allowing for powerful plays with cards like Academic Dispute and Boomerang Basics. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and versatile aggression strategy.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. It utilizes efficient mana sources like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to ramp up, while also including cards like Fiend Artisan and Formidable Speaker to benefit from having multiple creatures on the field. With a mix of powerful creatures like Shang-Chi and Ouroboroid, as well as game-changing cards like Nature's Rhythm and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl, this deck aims to win the game swiftly and decisively.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game. It uses cards like Spell Pierce and Divide by Zero to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also generating card advantage through cards like Accumulate Wisdom and It'll Quench Ya! The win condition is to slowly chip away at the opponent's life total using efficient removal spells and potentially closing out the game with powerful Planeswalkers like Ral, Crackling Wit. The deck aims to outsmart and outlast the opponent until victory is achieved.

This deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred and Sentinel of the Nameless City. It also utilizes lands like Boseiju and Urborg to provide additional utility and mana fixing. The goal is to slowly grind down the opponent's resources while deploying threats that are difficult to deal with, eventually overwhelming them with powerful plays and card advantage. The deck excels at dismantling opposing strategies and controlling the pace of the game until it can secure a victory.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure on the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger. The deck also focuses on card draw and manipulation to maintain consistency and find key cards quickly. Reckless Rage and Burst Lightning provide removal options while also contributing to damage output. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain control of the board through efficient spells and aggressive creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by drawing cards, countering opponent's spells, and removing threats with burn spells. The deck utilizes a mix of card draw, removal, and counter spells to maintain board control. With the inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Thor, God of Thunder and efficient creatures like Questing Druid, the deck aims to out-value and out-tempo the opponent. The mana base includes various dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing for the Izzet colors. Overall, the deck aims to have answers for any situation and ultimately come out ahead in the late game.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing card advantage, counter spells, and board wipes to control the game until the player can establish a dominant position. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with counterspells like Dovin's Veto, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own resources. The deck also includes a mix of lands for consistency and utility, along with some card draw and removal spells to maintain control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on using low-cost spells and creatures to quickly apply pressure to the opponent, aiming to win the game as fast as possible by dealing direct damage and overwhelming the opponent's defenses. The deck utilizes a mix of burn spells, prowess creatures, and card draw to maintain a steady stream of threats while keeping the opponent on the back foot. It aims to outpace the opponent in damage output and card advantage, utilizing the UR color combination for versatility and flexibility in its aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal, and card draw. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games. The deck utilizes a combination of counterspells like Dovin's Veto and Spell Snare, removal spells like Field of Ruin and Supreme Verdict, and card draw like Omen of the Sea and Memory Deluge to maintain control over the game. By consistently disrupting the opponent's plans and generating card advantage, the deck seeks to outvalue and outlast its opponent.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to control the board early with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Monastery Swiftspear, while also utilizing direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional sources of damage, while cards like Soul-Scar Mage and Sunspine Lynx help to efficiently chip away at the opponent's life total. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with consistent and fast damage output.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and cantrips to quickly trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard. By efficiently casting spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe, and drawing cards with Opt and Treasure Cruise, the deck aims to constantly bring back Arclight Phoenix while pressuring the opponent with the aggro strategy. The inclusion of Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster adds to the spell-slinging theme, while providing additional ways to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes some utility cards like Prismari Command and Into the Flood Maw for versatility.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while also disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The deck includes evasive creatures like Spyglass Siren and Moon-Circuit Hacker to make it difficult for the opponent to block effectively. In addition, cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can help control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Unholy Annex/Ritual Chamber and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide additional versatility and power to the deck.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards to generate overwhelming advantage and control over the opponent. By using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and end the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to efficiently execute the combo pieces while managing resources effectively to secure victory.
